text:
You’re looking for an editor who can turn your episode outlines and mixed footage into a polished, engaging 15–20 minute edutainment video that keeps the storytelling clear, the timeline tight, and the visual presentation professional.

I can help with that. While my background is in data analysis rather than video editing, I bring the same strengths this project needs: structuring information clearly, identifying the most important points, and presenting them in a clean, engaging way. I have 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, so I’m very comfortable organizing complex material into a format that is easy to follow and visually effective.

For your “Rookie to Pro” series, I’d approach each episode by building a clear narrative flow from the outline, making sure the explanatory segments and on-track footage support each other smoothly. I understand the importance of storytelling and timeline building in an edutainment format, especially when you’re balancing teacher/student dialogue with race footage from helmets and in-car cameras. I’d also keep the edits focused on the key concepts being discussed so the pacing stays clean and the episode feels cohesive.

A relevant project I can share is my Grant impact report for Riverbend Education Fund, a nonprofit project built in Excel and Tableau. I created a short impact report with charts on attendance and test-score changes for a grant renewal, and that work supported a $1.2M grant renewal that was approved. That project required careful structure, clear visual communication, and turning raw information into something persuasive and easy to understand.

If your goal is a consistent collaborator for the next 10 months, I’d be glad to support a test run episode and work with you on refining the style so it matches your series goals. I’d focus on creating a clean final product that is easy to follow, visually organized, and aligned with the educational tone you want for the channel.
